rows.en:
(Maybe I'll have Galaxy Ramen at Nyan-Nyan
for lunch today.)
(Wait, is that Michel coming out of the shop?)
Heeey, Michel~!

Oh, it's \p.
Came to Nyan-Nyan for some Galaxy Ramen?

Yeah, that's right.
Do you come to Nyan-Nyan a lot, Michel?

Yeah, I come here a lot with the crew
from my part-time job.
rows.notes: baito-saki no yatsura: 'the crew from my part-time job', kept gender-neutral; Michel's job (S.M.S.) is a secret in this arc.

rows.en:
Well, I'd better get going.
See ya.

(Come to think of it, where does Michel
work part-time, anyway?)

(Maybe I'll have Galaxy Ramen at Nyan-Nyan
for lunch today.)
(Wait, is that Michel-kun coming out of the shop?)
Heeey, Michel-kun~!

Yeah, that's right.
Do you come to Nyan-Nyan a lot, Michel-kun?

(Come to think of it, where does Michel-kun
work part-time, I wonder?)
(A hot day like this is perfect pool weather.)

Michel, you're not even getting in the pool.
What are you staring at so intently?

I figured it'd be rude not to take a good,
long look at Nanase and Akimizu
in their swimsuits.
Geez, obviously I'm kidding...
Come on, let's hurry up and swim.

(Michel, that did NOT sound like a joke
at all...)
(A hot day like this is perfect pool weather.)

Michel-kun, you're not even getting in the pool.
What are you staring at so intently?

(Michel-kun, that did NOT sound like a joke
at all...)
(I'd better hurry to the next classroom...)

(Wait, Michel? What's he doing?
If he doesn't hurry, class is gonna start.)

You look a lot like Sheryl, Senpai.
Has anyone ever told you that?
Ehh~ I don't look anything like Sheryl~
Looking closer...
You're right. It seems I was mistaken...

Because you're far more beautiful
than Sheryl, Senpai...
Oh, stop it. Smooth talker as always...
Not at all. I was merely stating the facts.

rows.notes: Four-ellipsis silence shared by many speakers; rendered '......' like the five-ellipsis c00059.

rows.en:
(Watching that just now, it hit me all over again:
I could never be like Michel...)

(Wait, Michel-kun? What's he doing?
If he doesn't hurry, class is gonna start.)
(Okay, I'd better hurry to the next classroom...)

(Okay, it's lunchtime.
Who should I eat with today?)
(Oh, there's Michel.)

Heeey, Michel~!
Wanna go get lunch together?

Hm? Oh, it's just you, \p...
Well, I don't mind, I guess...
You sound kind of let down that it's me.

It's not that I'm let down...
It's just, I'd rather eat with a beautiful woman.
...Well, sorry for being a guy.

Haha, I'm kidding.
Come on, if we don't hurry,
all the cafeteria seats'll be taken.
Yeah, let's go.

(For all his talk, Michel always ends up
eating with me anyway.)

(Okay, it's lunchtime.
Who should I eat with today?)
(Oh, there's Michel-kun.)

Heeey, Michel-kun~!
Wanna go get lunch together?
You sound kind of let down that it's me.

Haha, I'm kidding.
Allow me to escort you properly,
my lady.

Come on, if we don't hurry,
all the cafeteria seats'll be taken.
Yeah, let's go.

(For all his talk, Michel-kun always ends up
eating with me anyway.)

(Whoa, I was doing research in the library,
and now look how late it is.)

Oh, if it isn't \p.
What've you been up to this late?

Research in the library.
What about you, Michel? What've you been doing?

One of the upperclassmen called me over,
so I just got back from enjoying some tea.
rows.notes: senpai as a common noun: 'one of the upperclassmen', gender left open (the player later calls them onee-sama-gata, 'the older girls').

rows.en: Being this popular sure is rough on a guy.

Well, I'd better go, or I'll be late
for my part-time job. See ya.
(Michel sure is popular with the older girls.)

(Whoa, I was doing research in the library,
and now look how late it is.)

Research in the library.
What about you, Michel-kun?
What've you been doing?
(Michel-kun sure is popular with the older girls.)

uncertain: c18130: 'the crew from my part-time job' (gender-neutral for baito-saki no yatsura).
c18181: senpai kept gender-neutral as 'one of the upperclassmen'.
c18156: four-ellipsis silence (x11, many speakers) given as '......' to match c00059.
